svg.title: A cadet's scores, flight after flight, bouncing around their average.
svg.desc: A line of nine scores rises and falls around a dashed line for the cadet's average. Twice the cadet has a high score and is praised, and the next score falls back toward the average. Once the cadet has a low score and is scolded, and the next score rises toward the average. The praise and the scolding made no difference: extreme results are usually followed by less extreme ones.
